name: io.github.KalanosAI/kalanos-mcp
title: Kalanos Robotics Dataset Audits
description: Find public robotics dataset audits, including LeRobot. See what was checked and flagged.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Lists public Kalanos Hub datasets alphabetically by slug. Supports a literal substring match on the slug or source reference and exact filters for format, robot, license, report kind, minimum readiness, and minimum episode count. Each result includes readiness, episode count, robot, format, license, and label availability where present. The default page size is 10 (range 1–25; larger values are clamped to 25). next_after is the pagination cursor and is null at the end.

query.description: Literal substring (not a pattern) matched against the dataset slug and source reference; max 128 characters.

after.description: Pagination cursor: the next_after value from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Page size. Values from 1 to 50 are accepted and values above 25 are clamped to 25. Default 10.

format.description: Exact match on the dataset format.

license.description: Exact match on the license identifier.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Searches public Kalanos Hub datasets by slug, source reference, and report summary text. Results are ranked by BM25 relevance when q is present and by score otherwise. Supports format, robot, license, report kind, minimum episode count, maximum dataset size, and minimum duration filters. Results include the dataset slug and published assessment summary. Pages contain up to 25 results with total and facet counts; page.next_page identifies the next page.

q.description: Text matched against the dataset slug, source reference and report summary text, ranked by BM25; max 128 characters. When omitted, results are ranked by score.

format.description: Dataset formats to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

robot.description: Robots (embodiments) to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

license.description: License identifiers to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

report_kind.description: Report kinds to include: metadata, full, or both; matches any listed value.

page.description: 1-based page number; 25 results per page. Default 1.

tools.name: search_combined_datasets
tools.description: Finds public datasets by task, object, scene, and dataset metadata or scale. Values within a filter group are ORed, groups are ANDed, and episode filters match the same episode. Without episode filters, q can match dataset metadata or episode labels; with them, it matches the same episode. Results are dataset-level and sorted by readiness (direction asc or desc) with null scores last. Pages contain up to 20, 40, or 80 datasets (per_page) and include has_more. Filtered results may include matching episode counts; facets=true on a filtered request adds full-result facets, totals, and a summary. Unfiltered browse results omit facets and matching episode counts.

q.description: Text matched against dataset metadata or episode labels; when episode filters are present it matches the same episode. Max 128 characters.

dataset.description: Dataset source reference to restrict results to.

revision.description: Dataset revision (source commit) to restrict results to.

task.description: Task family labels, such as pick or place; matches any listed value (max 10).

objects.description: Object names; matches any listed value (max 10).

scene.description: Scene labels, such as kitchen or warehouse; matches any listed value (max 10).

format.description: Dataset formats to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

robot.description: Robots (embodiments) to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

license.description: License identifiers to include (max 20); matches any listed value.

report_kind.description: Report kinds to include: metadata, full, or both; matches any listed value.

page.description: 1-based dataset page number; out-of-range values are clamped. Default 1.

direction.description: Readiness sort direction: asc or desc. Default desc.

facets.description: When true on a filtered request, adds full-result facets, totals and a summary at higher cost. Default false.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Returns the current public assessment for one report ID or dataset identifier. The report can include readiness, episode decision counts, findings summaries, evaluated and unavailable checks, dataset metadata, and report revision. Omitted sections returns full JSON; sections absent from the assessment may be null. format=markdown is available when a published audit artifact exists; sections applies to JSON only. Historical revisions are not available; an optional revision check rejects a stale request.

report_id.description: Report identifier. Either report_id or dataset is required.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier: source reference (org/name), hf/org/name, or the @tenant/hf/org/name slug shown in listings. Either dataset or report_id is required.

report_revision.description: Report revision to check against; the request is rejected as stale if the current revision differs.

dataset_revision.description: Dataset revision (source commit) to check against; the request is rejected if it differs.

sections.description: Report sections to return. Omitted returns the full JSON. JSON only; not supported with format markdown.

format.description: Output format: json or markdown. Markdown is available when a published audit artifact exists. Default json.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Returns a page of recorded episodes and their findings at the requested report revision, including episodes without findings. view=full includes available evidence and video references (limit 1–10, default 5); view=selection returns decisions, resolved reasons, and candidate source indices (limit 1–100, default 5). after is a presentation offset, not a source episode index. Episode keys and candidate indices are not verified source indices. page.next_after is the continuation offset. Page caps (120,000 UTF-8 JSON bytes) can reduce the number of whole episodes returned; if one episode cannot fit, the response identifies its position and the applicable limit error (episode_exceeds_output_limit or episode_exceeds_read_limit). Unresolved reason references are preserved.

report_id.description: Report identifier. Either report_id or dataset is required.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier: source reference (org/name), hf/org/name, or the @tenant/hf/org/name slug shown in listings. Either dataset or report_id is required.

report_revision.description: Report revision the findings are read at; the request is rejected as stale if the current revision differs.

dataset_revision.description: Dataset revision (source commit) to check against; the request is rejected if it differs.

after.description: Zero-based presentation offset, not a source episode index. The page.next_after value of the previous response is the next offset. Default 0.

limit.description: Episodes per page: 1 to 10 for view full, 1 to 100 for view selection. Default 5. A page may return fewer whole episodes to fit size limits.

view.description: full includes evidence and video references; selection returns decisions, resolved reasons and candidate source indices. Default full.

tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Searches public episodes within one dataset (source_ref, e.g. lerobot/pusht) by task, object, scene, or words in task descriptions and labels. A missing or blank dataset returns search_scope_required. Values within a filter group are ORed; groups are ANDed. Results include matching episode rows, labels, review status when available, and dataset facet counts. Labels describe episode content and are distinct from assessment decisions.

q.description: Words matched against task descriptions and labels; max 128 characters.

dataset.description: Dataset source reference to search within, such as lerobot/pusht. A missing or blank value returns search_scope_required.

task.description: Task family labels; matches any listed value (max 10).

objects.description: Object names; matches any listed value (max 10).

scene.description: Scene labels; matches any listed value (max 10).

after.description: Zero-based offset into matching episodes. The page.next_after value of the previous response is the next offset. Default 0.
